title: Airbus BelugaXL 運輸機
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以BelugaXL大型航空部件運輸的公開角色，練習超大件幾何包絡、門口路徑、地板載荷及供應鏈交接；容積不等於載重許可。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use BelugaXL public oversize-component logistics to practice geometric envelopes, doorway paths, floor loading and supply-chain handover; volume is not payload permission. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 大型部件的裝載路徑：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Loading path for an oversize section: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 大型部件的裝載路徑 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Loading path for an oversize section and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 可容納體積需扣除不可用空間；能裝入與能承載是不同檢查，還需門口包絡及地板負載。
steps.instructionEn: Usable volume excludes inaccessible space; fitting and carrying are different checks that also need doorway envelope and floor loading.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus BelugaXL 運輸機實際性能或製程：長L=8 m，寬W=4 m，高H=3 m，可用率u=0.7。式 Vuse=LWHu，基準結果 67.2 m³。適用條件：矩形包絡的原創示意，非Beluga或Dreamlifter實際貨艙尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus BelugaXL transport aircraft: L=8 m, W=4 m, H=3 m and usable fraction u=0.7. Formula Vuse=LWHu gives 67.2 m³. Conditions: Original rectangular-envelope example, not actual Beluga or Dreamlifter dimensions.
steps.failure: 總容積足夠的貨物仍可能無法通過門口或轉彎。
steps.failureEn: Cargo with an adequate total-volume allowance can still fail the doorway or turn.
steps.check: 在模型同時檢查貨物外形、通過門口的路徑與固定點位置。
steps.checkEn: Check cargo shape, path through the door and restraint-point positions in the model.

knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把u改成0.6；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 67.2 改為 57.6 m³。在算式區重算並記下對「大型部件的裝載路徑」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only usable fraction to 0.6, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 67.2 to 57.6 m³. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Loading path for an oversize section, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 專用支架的接觸負載：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Contact loading of a transport cradle: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 專用支架的接觸負載 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contact loading of a transport cradle and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重量除接觸面積得到平均壓力；集中載荷、輪距與地板梁位置決定局部需求。
steps.instructionEn: Weight divided by contact area gives mean pressure; concentrated loads, wheel spacing and floor-beam location determine local demand.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus BelugaXL 運輸機實際性能或製程：m=500 kg，A=0.5 m²。式 p=mg/A，基準結果 9.81 kPa。適用條件：平均靜壓教學值，沒有機型地板承載限值。 以Pa算出的壓力除1000轉kPa。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus BelugaXL transport aircraft: m=500 kg and contact area A=0.5 m². Formula p=mg/A gives 9.81 kPa. Conditions: Average static teaching pressure without aircraft floor-load limits. Divide pascals by 1000 for kPa.
steps.failure: 用整個貨物投影面積取代實際腳輪接觸面積會低估局部壓力。
steps.failureEn: Using the cargo footprint instead of wheel contacts understates local pressure.
steps.check: 畫接觸區與支承梁疊圖，分開核對總重、線載及局部壓力。
steps.checkEn: Overlay contact areas and supporting beams and separately check total weight, line load and local pressure.
